summary: Analyzes the threats to the Unidirectional Lightweight Encapsulation protocol, which carries IP over MPEG-2 transport streams, and derives security requirements. It gives the motivation for link-layer security for a ULE stream. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: Sending Internet traffic through a TV signal means anyone with a dish can listen. This memo lists what could go wrong and what protections are needed.

questions: ip over mpeg-2 transport stream security
